claim: DD Form 1561 is the Statement to Substantiate Payment of FSA, edition DEC 2017, still current
quote: DD FORM 1561, DEC 2017 STATEMENT TO SUBSTANTIATE PAYMENT OF FAMILY SEPARATION ALLOWANCE (FSA)

claim: Form substantiates FSA for Marines separated from dependents for 30 or more continuous days
source: DoD FMR Vol 7A Ch 27 para 2.3.1.2 and 2.3.1.3
quote: FSA-T: TDY or TAD away from their PDS or homeport continuously for more than 30 days
fix: Change "30 or more" to "more than 30 continuous days" for FSA-S and FSA-T. FSA-R carries no 30-day test.

claim: Form covers FSA-R (unaccompanied tours), FSA-S (ship) and FSA-T (TDY or TAD over 30 days)
quote: FSA-Restricted (FSA-R), FSA-Ship (FSA-S), and FSA-Temporary (FSA-T). Members must complete a DoD (DD) Form 1561

claim: Quoted purpose text from the Privacy Act statement
quote: To substantiate payment of Family Separation Allowance (FSA); provides an audit trail for validating propriety of payments

claim: Member completes the form, identifies dependent location, certifies separation and acknowledges termination conditions
source: DD Form 1561 Part I blocks 7 to 9
quote: PART I - MEMBER COMPLETES THIS SECTION TO SUBSTANTIATE ENTITLEMENT TO FSA

claim: Signing section omitted: the page never names the certifying officer who completes Part II and signs block 15
quote: PART II - CERTIFYING OFFICER COMPLETES THE APPROPRIATE SECTION(S) BELOW
fix: Add that a certifying officer completes Part II (TDY, PCS or ship data) and signs block 15d.

claim: S-1 or servicing PAC processes entitlement through UD/MIPS and the reporting unit routes through DFAS Marine Corps Pay
quote: local commands and IPACs will upload MILPAY related documents
fix: Cite a paragraph or drop the UD/MIPS and DFAS routing sentence. No cached source names that routing.

claim: FMR Vol 7A Ch 27 para 2.1 requires the completed DD 1561 before FSA pays
quote: Members must complete a DoD (DD) Form 1561 (Statement to Substantiate Payment of Family Separation Allowance) to substantiate entitlement to FSA.

claim: A fresh form supports each new qualifying separation and the member submits an updated form whenever the situation changes
quote: I must notify my commanding officer immediately upon any change in dependency status
fix: Say the member notifies the commanding officer of a dependency change. The form does not call for a resubmitted form.

claim: MCAAT military pay checklist asks if DD 1561 is filed in OMPF within 10 working days of the unit diary date (item 70) and of the effective date (item 06), citing DoDFMR 7A Ch 27, MCO 1070.1 and MAA 1-20 para 4.b.(1)
quote: properly completed and filed in OMPF within 10 working days from the date reported on unit diary

claim: MAA 1-20 (MARADMIN 015/20) para 4.b.1 lists DD 1561 as a MILPAY document for OMPF Field Folder upload
quote: Family Separation Allowance (FSA). DD Form 1561 (Family Separation Allowance, Statement to Substantiate Payment of)

claim: MARADMIN 015/20 (MAA 1-20) is cancelled by PAA 03-20 (supersession candidate)
quote: The purpose of this PAA is to provide amplifying guidance to reference (a).
fix: Candidate rejected. PAA 03-20 amplifies MAA 1-20 and does not cancel it. The cache holds a second message also numbered 015/20 (cancellation of MARADMIN 192/20), so keep the MAA 1-20 title beside the number.

claim: A missing form creates a documentation gap flagged during PAC audit
quote: MCAAT will verify the existence, accuracy and completeness of the above during their visits

claim: MARADMIN 150/26 sets FSA at 300 dollars per month effective 18 December 2025, up from 250, under the FY2026 NDAA
quote: Effective 18 December 2025, the monthly FSA rate is increased from $250 to $300

claim: MCTFS auto-updated eligible records to the new rate
quote: An automated process adjusted all records for Marines entitled to FSA on or after 18 December 2025.

claim: MARADMIN 150/26 names S-1 staff as the processors of DD 1561 substantiation and FSA starts and stops
quote: Disbursing/Finance Offices and administrative units will ensure proper entitlement and payment of the new FSA rate
fix: The message addresses Disbursing/Finance Offices and administrative units and never mentions DD 1561 or S-1. Remove the attribution.
